answer: PoA assigns reputation through EigenTrust, then applies an exponential temporal half-life: influence must be renewed by sustained, honestly validated service. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths, and colluders cannot bootstrap it without reciprocal credibility. It therefore cannot pass consensus; a node may wander through a grove or mention yarrow, but neither creates trust.
